title: Hypnos model record
description: One population PK/PD model of one drug for one purpose. The unit of curation.

kernel.description: Binding to the pure-Python reference kernel that instantiates this model from covariates.

function.description: registry key of the covariate->parameters function

covariate_model.description: Verbatim published equation, for human verification and export.

lbm_equation.description: Named lean-body-mass / fat-free-mass equation (choice has documented failure modes).

crcl_ml_min.description: Creatinine-clearance range the model was fit across (renal-function dimension, v0.5 §B4). Absent => the model claims no renal-impairment standing.

albumin_g_dl.description: Serum-albumin range the model was fit across (free-fraction dimension, v0.5 §B3/§B4).

ejection_fraction_pct.description: Cardiac-output / ejection-fraction range the model was fit across (v0.5 §B4).

organ_tolerance.description: Cited mechanistic standing in an organ-failure state the model was NOT fit in (e.g. remifentanil's esterase clearance is hepatic/renal-independent). Grants envelope standing on that axis without a refitted model (v0.5 §B3). Absent => no standing; an organ-impaired patient is greyed + Tier-D.

basis.description: The cited mechanistic reason for standing.

caveat.description: A residual caveat even given standing (e.g. renal accumulation of an active metabolite).

toxicity_thresholds.description: Systemic-toxicity threshold RANGES for a local anesthetic (v0.6 spec §3.3). ALWAYS a range with low<high and an explicit basis — never a single 'toxic at X' line. The schema forbids a single-value threshold by construction (both range bounds are required, non-null).

variability_status.description: Rollup of how much of the NLME random-effects structure is curated; drives band eligibility (v0.2 spec §5).

uncertainty_status.description: Rollup of curated ESTIMATION uncertainty (distinct from variability_status); drives confidence-band eligibility + the UI badge (v0.3 spec §5). 'none' => no confidence band drawn (never-synthesize).

external_validation.description: Hypnos-COMPUTED Varvel metrics against open data, reproducible and distinct from the human-curated publisher-reported predictive_performance (v0.4 spec §4.1).

validation_status.description: Rollup of external-validation coverage; UI badge + tier-falsification input (v0.4 spec §4.3).

parameter_variability.description: Between-subject (and optional inter-occasion) variability for ONE structural parameter (v0.2 spec §3.1). Has its own tier and extraction, independent of the point-estimate tier.

bsv.description: Between-subject variability on the eta (log) scale by default.

omega2.description: CANONICAL: variance on the eta scale (the NONMEM $OMEGA diagonal entry).

distribution.description: exponential (log-normal) BSV unless stated; additive BSV puts omega2 on the natural scale.

cv_percent.description: OPTIONAL human-readable convenience; checked-consistent with omega2 (spec §4 Trap 1).

shrinkage_percent.description: eta-shrinkage if the source reports it (interpretation caveat, spec §4 Trap 4).

omega2_se.description: SE on the curated BSV variance ω² — second-order ESTIMATION uncertainty on this v0.2 layer (v0.3 §2.2). RSE on the VARIANCE, not the SD (v0.3 §4 Trap 5).

iov.description: Inter-occasion variability, only when separately published; NEVER folded into bsv (spec §2.3).

residual_error.description: Residual unexplained variability — the Sigma layer (v0.2 spec §3.2). Each term labels its scale (variance vs sd) in the key name, because variance-vs-SD is the most common Sigma transcription error.

sd.description: sigma_add in concentration units (note: SD, not variance).

log.description: Additive error on the natural-log concentration scale (approx. proportional on the natural scale).

omega_block.description: Published off-diagonal Omega (correlated random effects). Present only when the source publishes covariances/correlations (v0.2 spec §3.3).

complete.description: false => only the listed pairs are published; the rest are UNKNOWN, not zero.

estimation_uncertainty.description: Per-θ ESTIMATION uncertainty — the SE/RSE/CI on the estimated typical value (v0.3 spec §2.1). REDUCIBLE (shrinks with more data), and a DIFFERENT number from the BSV in `variability` (irreducible). Lives BESIDE `variability`, never inside it — the schema separation mirrors the conceptual one, so an RSE can never be silently read as a between-subject CV (v0.3 §4 Trap 1).

se.description: CANONICAL: standard error on the estimated `scale`.

scale.description: Mandatory whenever an SE is present — a log-scale SE applied as natural-scale is silently wrong (v0.3 §4 Trap 2).

rse_percent.description: OPTIONAL convenience; checked-consistent with `se` and `value.central` on the declared scale (Trap 2).

ci95.description: OPTIONAL 95% CI; asymptotic unless `method` says otherwise (bootstrap/SIR CIs stored verbatim).

absorption.description: Site-specific systemic absorption for a local anesthetic (v0.6 spec §3.1). The rate of rise of plasma concentration is a curated function of INJECTION SITE — the headline that the mg/kg max-dose tables are unreliable because absorption is site-driven, not milligram-driven.

ka.description: First-order absorption rate constant (1/min); often Tier-C in magnitude even where the `rank` is robust.

rank.description: Systemic-absorption rank (1 = fastest/highest peak). The DIRECTION is curated even where `ka` magnitude is not (v0.6 §3.1).

toxicity_threshold.description: One systemic-toxicity threshold RANGE for one endpoint (v0.6 spec §3.3). The safety-critical block: a range, never a line. `basis` (total vs free plasma) is mandatory because a free-drug threshold compared against a total-drug prediction is silently wrong (v0.6 §4 Trap 1). For a saturable-binding drug on a total_plasma basis, `saturation_caveat` is required (the free fraction rises non-linearly when total is highest — total under-predicts risk exactly when it is greatest; v0.6 §3.2/§4).

endpoint.description: The toxicity endpoint. The clinical warning sequence is cns_first_symptoms (perioral numbness/tinnitus) -> cns_seizure -> cardiovascular (conduction block/arrhythmia/arrest); for the most cardiotoxic agents the CNS-warning margin can be narrow or absent (v0.6 §3.3).

concentration_range.description: The threshold RANGE. Both bounds are required and non-null — a single-value threshold is a schema error by construction (v0.6 §4).

low.description: Lower bound of the published threshold range (low < high enforced by `hypnos validate`).

high.description: Upper bound of the published threshold range.

basis.description: Whether the range is reported on TOTAL or FREE plasma concentration — drives the §3.2 free-fraction caveat and prevents the total-vs-free conversion error (Trap 1).

individual_variability.description: Qualitative: thresholds are person- and rate-of-rise-dependent; usually 'high'.

method_caveat.description: Derivation context (e.g. volunteer slow-infusion study) so the number is never read as context-free (Trap 3 — speed-of-rise dependence).

saturation_caveat.description: REQUIRED when the drug's binding is saturable and `basis` is total_plasma: names the free-fraction under-prediction failure mode (v0.6 §3.2/§4; enforced by `hypnos validate`).

estimate_covariance.description: Published estimate correlation/covariance — the NONMEM $COV output (v0.3 spec §2.3/§3.2). The estimation-layer analog of `omega_block`, but for ESTIMATION covariance, and NEVER merged with the random-effect covariance.

complete.description: false => only listed estimate pairs published; the rest UNKNOWN, not zero (independence assumed only with a recorded caveat).

covariance_step_succeeded.description: NONMEM $COV often fails; record honestly — an absent SE is then MISSING, not zero (v0.3 §4 Trap 4).

external_validation_entry.description: One Hypnos-computed metric set for one model against one open dataset, in one validation mode and cohort stratum (v0.4 spec §4.1).

provenance.description: What makes the metric reproducible — NOT a human PDF verification.

reproducible.description: Distinguishes this computed block from the human-curated predictive_performance.
